title: XOR Transformations (Hard Version)
statement: An array of n integers is repeatedly replaced by the n smallest pairwise XORs of its elements. For q independent queries x, the task is to report max minus min after x transformations. With n, q up to 1e5, values below 2^30 and x up to 2^30, the array reaches a fixed point within O(log C) steps, each a k-smallest pairwise XOR computation on a binary trie.
